in_marathi.name: Devaprabha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devaprabha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devaprabha is a Sanskrit name meaning 'God's Illumination'. It is derived from the words 'Deva' meaning 'god' and 'Prabha' meaning 'illumination' or 'light'. This name is associated with spiritual enlightenment and the divine presence.
